title: a market is a set of towns, and the zip decides which one a person is in

criteria.text: A market is a row of whole counties and split-county subdivisions; every other county is its own waiting market; moving one is one row; may cross states
criteria.note: [V] `markets`, `market_members`, `market_key()` (#693, PR #708, review-skipped, deploy-health green on 4431c25). Checked: yes, `tests/f103-markets-db.test.ts` marked F103.1 (#850, PR #910, green on 82a9edc): Sacramento's counties and the Tahoe carve-outs, every US county in exactly one market, one row moves a county, and a Nevada county joins Tahoe; seen failing against a market_key that ignores out-of-state members. The 2026-10-27 ruling (F103 Rulings; web #1101, open, no PR yet) grows Sacramento to its 60-minute drive-time reach (Yuba City, Marysville, Vacaville, Dixon, Grass Valley, Nevada City) by an assignment script and an overrides file, reviewed as a diff of market_members rows first: it changes which rows, not the mechanism, so the criterion's example list is overtaken (sync-roadmap amends it) and the cells stand

criteria.text: A zip resolves to exactly one market the same way every time (zip to county to market; subdivision inside a split county); unknown zip refused with the exact words
criteria.note: [V] `zip_county`, `zip_market_key`, refusal "We don't recognize that zip, try again." (#694, PR #709, review-skipped, green on 4f571f5); Connecticut's planning regions added by #959 (green on 4f691c0). Checked: yes for this row, `tests/f103-markets-db.test.ts` marked F103.2 partial (#850): zip → county → market, the subdivision decides inside split Placer, one county per zip, same answer every time, unknown zip refused; seen failing against a lookup that ignores the subdivision. The marker is partial only for the source (row 2b, #849). Nothing touched it since 10-23 (git log)

criteria.text: The zip-to-county source is the HUD-USPS crosswalk, largest residential share wins
criteria.note: [V] stand-in: Census 2020 ZCTA files, largest land area, 10,174 zips flagged `guess`; PO-box-only zips unknown (#694 PR body, #693 comment; scripts/generate-zip-county-migration.ts). HUD token not registered; #849 open with the PM (needs-pm), no comment since filing on 2026-10-16

criteria.text: The zip decides, nobody picks: open market signs in, waiting market joins that waitlist and is named; no IP, GPS, default, shortlist or picker
criteria.note: [V] Checked: yes, `tests/signup-zip-market-db.test.tsx` marked F103.3 (#850, PR #910): an open zip signs the person in and names the market, a waiting zip names its market and joins that waitlist, nothing to pick, and a scan finds no IP, position or default on the signup path; seen failing against a default market. The zip step is reached through the profile screen, which every new member now lands on since #1032 (F081.1). Explore's visitor fallback is F104/F105 (#588), not sign-up

criteria.text: Nothing member-facing reads the MSA or CSA; no surface shows MSA, CSA or metro
criteria.note: [V] #1038 (2026-10-24, closes #1015; human-review, review-skipped; deploy-health green on 337830c): every leftover 'metro' became 'area' (area picker, not-covered panel, waitlist step, waitlist popup, Page location line, Privacy page, seeder message), and neighbourhood search, /api/boundaries and the main-town anchor no longer filter by places.msa_code or take an msa parameter; saveDefaultMetroAction removed; markets.msa_code stays report-only. Checked: yes, a standing guard: src/lib/copy-no-metro-words.test.ts marked [guards F103.4] whole scans member-facing .tsx prose and .ts string literals for metro, MSA and CSA (only RecruitmentGrid's farm 'CSA' allow-listed) and fails on any msa_code or ?msa= read in app code; seen failing before the swap (3 screen strings, 7 .ts strings) and against the old neighborhood-search.ts. Reads of metro_polygons by the waitlist handlers remain (grep 2026-10-30): that is the waitlist table keyed from markets.metro_id, not the MSA code. Smoked: explore and /you opened green 2026-10-25, 10-26, 10-27 and explore 10-30, all after the merge. PM looked: the PR asked for a look on socialus.org; no uat Issue or pm-reviewed label records one

criteria.text: A member in an open market has a home town (Place their zip mostly lies in, else county remainder), re-resolved when the zip changes, private
criteria.note: [V] `members.home_town`, `zip_home()`, `member.zip.set` (#695, PR #757, review-skipped, green on e0f16a9). Checked: yes for this row, `tests/f103-markets-db.test.ts` marked F103.5 partial (#850): signup stores the Place, a zip in no Place gives the county remainder, each move re-resolves it, and no visitor or other member reads it by row, view, function or page (town_board, F118, returns counts only); seen failing against a zip change that keeps the old town. The marker is partial only for the day-it-opens half (row 5b)

criteria.text: A member in a waiting market gets a home town the day it opens
criteria.note: [V] `backfill_home_towns(market)` exists, is idempotent and tested (`home-town-db.test`), service_role-only since #919. Since #1056 (2026-10-25, #616) there is a way to open a market: scripts/market/open-market.ts calls openMarket (src/lib/market/open-market.ts), which sets markets.is_open and metro_polygons.is_open, sends the one message and discards the addresses; it never calls backfill_home_towns (lines 27-38, read 2026-10-30), so a member who signed up while the market waited keeps no home town after it opens. Filed today as #1112 (launch-blocking: one call in the opener, agents alone)
